limitations.note: The rewrite bypassed the original edge detector instead of restoring the registered light-output stage that lets the counter detect a new phase and reload.
The replacement FSM applies a held request on the green-entry edge, asserts red during reset instead of clearing all lights, and eliminates the original cycle at count zero before reload.

The test encoded the rewrite's immediate green shortening, red-on-reset behavior, and direct phase transitions rather than checking the registered-output and counter-reload timing the fix needed to preserve.

limitations.quote: preserve the established output latency and reset values unless the specification explicitly changes them
limitations.note: The agent read relevant timing guidance but did not use it to check how the light-output stage and counter reload depend on each other.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The test command had to be resubmitted because of its cleanup command, and an earlier Git check in a non-repository had already forced a separate retry of simulator discovery.
